subject: Private VPC follow-up: networking details & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@finserv.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@finserv.io>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC follow-up: networking details & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya,

Great to speak today — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks to keep the Private VPC timeline moving:  

Summary of requirements we heard today:
- Must use Private VPC (customer-managed) in AWS for inference traffic and KMS-controlled keys for secrets
- Prefer AWS PrivateLink for connectivity (avoid public endpoints) but open to VPC peering if there are account constraints
- IP allowlist for your internal CI / monitoring boxes (we'll provide a short-lived range during onboarding)
- Data residency: us-east-1; data retention policy: standard (30 days) with option to disable logs
- Expected initial capacity: ~5 concurrent inference nodes, burst to 15 during batch jobs

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you share your AWS account ID(s) for PrivateLink/VPC peering and the network contact we should loop in (name + email)?
2) Please confirm whether PrivateLink is required or if peering is acceptable (we can support both; PrivateLink is slightly faster to provision with our infra team).
3) I'll attach our private VPC checklist and a sample network diagram — can your infra team review and flag any blockers?
4) Sean (cc'd) will follow up on pricing / contract cadence once we confirm topology.

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-checklist.pdf (stub), network-diagram.png (stub)

Proposed timeline: once we have network contacts + account IDs, our network provisioning lead can spin up a trial PrivateLink endpoint in ~7 business days; peering may take longer depending on security review.

If that sounds right, we can draft a Mutual Action Plan and target an internal kickoff next week.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC follow-up: networking details & next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below:  

1) AWS account IDs: 111122223333 (primary), 444455556666 (analytics)
2) Preference: PrivateLink if possible — security team likes endpoint-centric models. If PrivateLink will materially delay rollout, we can consider peering as fallback.
3) Network contact: Priya Natarajan (priya@finserv.io), she runs infra and will review the checklist.
4) Capacity note: the initial 5 concurrent nodes is accurate; some overnight batch runs may spike to the 15 you mentioned.

Questions from our side:
- Can you share an estimated lead time and high-level SOW / pricing for Private VPC vs Dedicated? We need to budget for Q3 deployment.
- Do you require any customer-side changes to KMS policies?

I'm looping Priya in to pick through the network checklist. Priya — can you confirm availability for a short call this week?
